2A.5 SOTP ASSUMPTION SET — Alibaba Group (BABA), FY2027E (year ending Mar-2027)

Reconstructed GS-style SOTP block. Sources: FMP revenue-product-segmentation
FY26 (period 2026-03-31, CNY converted at 0.1376), FMP FY26 reported revenue,
GS "Navigating China Internet" 10 Aug 2026 (SOTP-based 12m TP US$186/HK$180,
Buy rated; key risks: GMV growth vs macro/competition, China retail
monetization, cloud deceleration), sell-side SOTP conventions for China
internet (15% holdco discount convention). Segment revenues scaled from the
FY26 reported segment mix to FY27E group revenue of ~US$143bn (±5% reconciles).

SEGMENT | name=Cloud Intelligence Group | rev_fwd_usd_bn=20.0 | ebit_margin_pct=9 | unit_economics=AI-driven IaaS+PaaS growth re-accelerating 30%+ yoy (Source: FMP FY26 Cloud Services 112bn CNY scaled) | multiple_ref=5.0x EV/Rev forward sales, re-rated on AI demand (Source: GS cloud re-rating, Aug 2025-2026)
